label: Posts & carousels
name: Content that makes your brand memorable
tagline: Carousels that make people stop, learn something and remember your name.

case.title: If Brazil had more railways, would your package arrive faster?
case.note: Personal project, created to show how I approach a brand awareness carousel. Slides in Portuguese.
case.lead: A brand awareness carousel. It makes people who don’t know Vaiê yet stop, learn something and remember who told them. That groundwork is what makes the next sales faster and cheaper.
facts: Entrepreneurs whose revenue depends on deliveries
strategy: Rides the post-election debate on infrastructure to reach people who have never heard of the brand.
Geography, politics and logistics at a macro level. The brand shows up in the scenery, on the box and on the van.
The last slides bring the topic into a business owner’s daily routine and sign off with the brand positioning.
arc: Hook: the question everyone thinks they can answer
Breaks the easy answer: new tracks take years
Goes deeper: finished tracks don’t mean fast delivery
The whole journey, from factory to the customer’s door
The mirror: a business owner’s routine

items: a sign the content was valuable
people who wanted to keep listening
winning over people who already trust you costs less
when it’s time to decide, the familiar brand wins
metrics.note: When middle-of-funnel content arrives, it talks to people who already know Vaiê. The conversation starts in the middle, not from zero.

case.why: It’s easier to buy cake from a cousin who bakes than from a stranger. Top-of-funnel content makes your brand that cousin.
case.cta: I want a carousel like this
case.waMessage: Hi Diogo, I saw the Vaiê carousel on your website and I’d like a strategic carousel like that
